tasks.title: Add typed `[shell]` and `[update_probe]` config parsing/validation/defaults. Cover valid/invalid `auto_refresh_notice` (`off|once|every`), probe mode (`off|passive|warn`), timeout/cache defaulting, and isolated env override expectations in unit tests. Update `stack.example.toml` skeleton for both sections.
tasks.implementation_summary: Added typed ShellSection and UpdateProbeSection, parsing for `[shell]` and `[update_probe]`, validation/defaulting for auto-refresh notice and probe settings, RED/GREEN tests, and stack.example.toml entries. Defaults: auto_refresh enabled, auto_refresh_notice=off, update_probe.default=passive, timeouts 3000/10000ms, cache TTL 5 minutes. Explicit non-positive numeric probe values reject while absent values default.

tasks.title: Implement read-only plugin update probe core. Add `internal/plugin/probe.go` with `DriftStatus`, `DriftResult`, `Probe`, and `ProbeAll`; use `git ls-remote` with git hardening and `GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0`; compare local HEAD/ref to remote without `git fetch`; enforce per-plugin/global timeouts and bounded parallelism. Add unit tests using fake subprocess hooks/local remotes proving no remote-tracking ref mutation.

tasks.title: Add shell drift surfacer. Managed hook reads `drift_cache.json` after stamp refresh; `off` suppresses, `passive` displays cached stale/update info only, `warn` runs `oca update --check --quiet` on cache miss/stale within configured timeout. Ensure no network call in default passive mode and no output in non-interactive shells. Add shell tests for cache states and once-per-shell warning guard.
tasks.implementation_summary: Added _oca_drift_surfacer to managed hook. It reads `$OCA_CACHE_DIR/drift_cache.json`, prints once when cached update_available status exists, suppresses in off mode, stays passive by default with no network call, and in warn mode runs `oca update --check --quiet` on missing cache within timeout. Hook runs after env refresh and remains guarded by interactive-shell check.

wisdom.content: For config fields where absent should default but explicit zero should be invalid, keep public scalar fields and add unexported `...Set` booleans captured via `UnmarshalTOML`. Validation can then distinguish absent from explicit zero without pointer-heavy call sites.

OCA-owned shell state can stay test-isolated without a new env var by deriving `~/.config/oca` as a sibling of `OCA_OPENCODE_CONFIG_DIR`. Tests override `OCA_OPENCODE_CONFIG_DIR=/tmp/.../opencode`, so env.sh lands at `/tmp/.../oca/env.sh` instead of production home.

When adding post-apply behavior, patch the common `emitPlanOrApplyWithOpts` path, not only special targets like temporal. Target-specific tests can pass while `apply --target plugins` still skips the post-action if the common emitter is missed.

`git ls-remote -- <source> <ref>` with `GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0` detects remote plugin updates without changing `refs/remotes/origin/*`; local bare-remotes make this property easy to prove in tests by comparing remote-tracking refs before/after.
